method: Two sequential 120-second native WebRTC runs using generated PCM and 600 depth-only packets at 5 Hz per run. Slow-receiver condition adds 800 ms completion delay after 60 seconds.
limitations: Generated PCM bypasses physical microphone DSP; synthetic depth packets bypass ARKit and JPEG encoding.
No matched old-build physical baseline in this batch; not proof the user-reported microphone issue is resolved.
RTCP feedback may lag. Transcription is model output, not a bit-perfect audio check.
result: No capture stalls or voice disconnects. Camera queue bounded to two. Both runs preserved 17 of 18 complete phrases: one early omission in the slow-receiver run, one late omission in the normal run. Progressive worsening was not reproduced; recognition is not lossless.
